messages:
maya: moving a customer escalation here — Borealis security team cannot access Audit Logs in Compliance UI. They get a clear 'You do not have permission to access audit logs' banner even though the affected users are listed as Org Admins in the UI.

laura.borealis: (customer) we re-synced SCIM twice and still see the error. user: laura@borealis.com (user_z9y8x7), org: org_5f6e7d8c. Screenshot attached to the ticket.

jorge: can you paste the user_id/org_id and last sync timestamp? sometimes role labels sync but entitlement bits aren't applied, which would explain the denial.

laura.borealis: org_5f6e7d8c, user_z9y8x7, last sync 2026-03-02T19:45:12Z.

elliot: quick triage checklist: 1) confirm role mapping (Admin vs Billing-only) 2) check entitlement flags in auth/entitlement service 3) inspect SCIM worker logs for any PATCH/422 errors.

samir: i pulled the scim worker logs for that org — SCIM PATCH succeeded but the entitlement update failed with a 422: unknown_entitlement: "audit_logs_retention_view_old". scim-mapper currently treats unknown entitlement keys as fatal and aborts the entire entitlement patch.

maya: customer says they can see "Retention controls" in Compliance but not the raw Audit Explorer — they need both audit_logs:read and retention visibility for audits.

jorge: i reproduced locally. repro steps below. expected behavior: scim-mapper should ignore unknown/legacy entitlement keys and apply the rest. actual: mapper returns 422 and no entitlements are applied.

```
# emulate SCIM PATCH containing a deprecated entitlement key
curl -X PATCH https://scim.redwood.internal/orgs/org_5f6e7d8c/users/user_z9y8x7 \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_KEY" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"entitlements": ["audit_logs:read","audit_logs_retention_view","audit_logs_retention_view_old"]}'
```

samir: confirmed in v2.1.2 scim-mapper logs — validation fails on the deprecated key and the entitlement-service never receives the update. so the user's role label looks like Admin but the underlying entitlement bits (audit_logs:read) are missing. explains UI denial.

maya: customer asks for an immediate workaround — can we apply the missing entitlements directly to entitlement-service for user_z9y8x7 while we fix the mapper?

jorge: i can do a one-off admin patch but need emergency approval for direct production entitlement writes. tagging @samir for security sign-off.

samir: approved for emergency remediation with audit trail. apply via admin endpoint; infra will log operator. payload below — i've executed it and verified the flags in the entitlement DB.

POST https://auth.redwood.internal/admin/entitlements
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "org_id": "org_5f6e7d8c",
  "user_id": "user_z9y8x7",
  "entitlements": ["audit_logs:read","audit_logs_retention_view"]
}

samir: after the admin patch i validated the entitlement-service row for org_5f6e7d8c/user_z9y8x7 shows both flags.

maya: asked the customer to hard-refresh and re-login to clear client cache.

laura.borealis: confirmed — audit explorer visible, retention controls present, can query events back 180 days. thanks! :tada:

elliot: i'm opening INFRA-4321 to change scim-mapper behavior to ignore unknown entitlement keys (whitelist validation + ignoreUnknown=true). also adding a backfill job to scan scim worker logs for 422 unknown_entitlement failures during the last deploy window (2026-02-20 to 2026-03-05) and repair affected orgs.

jorge: INFRA-4321 created with repro, logs, and suggested patch. proposed backfill plan includes: 1) scan logs for "unknown_entitlement" 422s 2) aggregate impacted user/org ids 3) apply admin entitlement patch for those rows and notify customers 4) monitor for regressions.

maya: scheduling handoff call with Borealis security next week to confirm SCIM schema stability and share postmortem.

incident-bot: Postmortem meeting scheduled for INFRA-4321 on 2026-03-04T16:00Z. Owners: jorge, elliot, samir, maya.

maya: closing the customer support escalation — leaving INFRA-4321 open until code fix + backfill complete. customer satisfied for now. :white_check_mark:
